scenario:
A global financial services company is developing an enterprise-level platform to manage and analyze historical stock market data. This platform aims to provide comprehensive data analytics and visualization tools to investment analysts, traders, and financial researchers. The system will store historical price data for various stock indices, enabling users to perform trend analysis, volatility assessment, and predictive modeling.

The platform must support the importation and storage of daily trading data, including open, high, low, and close prices for multiple stocks across different markets. Users should be able to query and visualize the data through interactive dashboards, customized reports, and real-time analytics tools.

The system will also feature a robust user management module that enables role-based access control, allowing different levels of data access and manipulation rights for traders, analysts, and researchers. Additionally, the platform will support data integration with external financial news and analytics services to enhance decision-making processes. Advanced features such as algorithmic trading backtesting and historical scenario simulation will be included to meet the demands of high-frequency trading environments.
